title: phocal / Plenum gateway
description: Plenum gateway telemetry (Effect OTLP -> Grafana Cloud). Source: plenum/observability/grafana/plenum-gateway.dashboard.ts

panels.title: Devices reporting
panels.description: Devices that completed at least one successful cycle in the range.

targets.expr: count(max_over_time(plenum_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Stalest device
panels.description: Seconds since the device that has gone longest without a successful cycle last succeeded. Uses the last value in the range, so a stopped gateway turns red instead of disappearing.

targets.expr: max(time() - max_over_time(plenum_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range]))

sum(rate(plenum_poll_cycles_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device", outcome="ok"}[$__range])) / sum(rate(plenum_poll_cycles_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Read failures (range)
panels.description: Cycles whose device read still failed after retries.

targets.expr: sum(increase(plenum_read_failures_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])) or vector(0)
sum(increase(plenum_publish_failures_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cycle p95
panels.description: Includes driver retries and publishing.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(plenum_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Cycles by outcome
panels.description: timed_out: a cycle hung past the device's cycleTimeoutMs (a device or the broker side that never answers) and was abandoned.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(plenum_poll_cycles_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Read failures by device and reason

targets.expr: sum by (device, reason) (rate(plenum_read_failures_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cycle duration p50 / p95 by device

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (device, le) (rate(plenum_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (device, le) (rate(plenum_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Values published vs suppressed by deadband
panels.description: A high suppressed share means the deadband is saving bandwidth; all published means it may be too tight.

targets.expr: sum(rate(plenum_values_published_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(plenum_values_suppressed_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
time() - max by (device) (plenum_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Device requests by outcome
panels.description: Every request a driver sent. exception = the device refused (check the point address); timeout and connection = it is unreachable.

targets.expr: sum by (device, outcome) (rate(plenum_driver_requests_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connections opened by device
panels.description: A healthy link connects once. Repeated ok connects mean it keeps dropping; failed means it cannot connect. $bacnet is the one UDP socket every BACnet device shares.

targets.expr: sum by (device, outcome) (increase(plenum_driver_connects_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Pipeline restarts by device
panels.description: A device's pipeline died on a bug (a defect, not a device or broker failure) and was restarted with backoff, up to every 5 minutes. Any restart is a bug to report; the gateway log has the cause. Other devices keep running.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (increase(plenum_device_restarts_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Device refusals by exception
panels.description: Reads a device refused, after retries. illegal_data_address on every cycle means a point address is wrong; busy and gateway exceptions come and go. The log has one warning when a refusal starts, not one per cycle.

targets.expr: sum by (device, exception) (increase(plenum_driver_refusals_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connected to the MQTT broker
panels.description: 1 while the gateway holds a broker connection. While it is 0, values go to the store-and-forward buffer if one is configured, and are lost otherwise.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (plenum_mqtt_connected{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Broker connection attempts by outcome
panels.description: A healthy gateway connects once. Repeated ok means the connection keeps dropping; failed means the broker is unreachable; rejected means it refused (check credentials).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(plenum_mqtt_connects_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Commands by outcome
panels.description: Commands received on site/building/device/point/$set. written reached the device; rejected was refused by the command guard (not writable, out of range, wrong type, retained) and never reached it; failed could not be written (device down, refused, no answer).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(plenum_commands_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Rejected and failed commands by reason
panels.description: Why commands did not get through. retained on every reconnect means a retained message sits on a $set topic: clear it on the broker. Every command is also in the logs.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, reason) (increase(plenum_commands_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device", outcome!="written"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Messages waiting in the buffer
panels.description: Rows in the SQLite outbox. It grows during a broker outage and falls back to 0 once the gateway has delivered them. A line that stays above 0 while the broker is connected means draining is stuck.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (plenum_buffer_rows{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Buffer traffic
panels.description: Stored during an outage, delivered after it. Dropped means data was lost: overflow when the outbox passed buffer.maxRows, rejected when the broker refused a stored message, unreadable when a stored row no longer decoded, undeliverable when a row broke the connection three times in a row, lost when the buffer file was corrupt or replaced.

targets.expr: sum(increase(plenum_buffer_written_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(increase(plenum_buffer_drained_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (reason) (increase(plenum_buffer_dropped_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Buffer store failures
panels.description: Failed SQLite operations on the outbox (a full disk, a busy or broken file). While inserts fail, live values go straight to the broker instead (published past the buffer); while deletes fail, delivered rows are remembered in memory and not sent again.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (increase(plenum_buffer_failures_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(increase(plenum_buffer_bypassed_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Running without a buffer
panels.description: 1 while the buffer file cannot be opened, so values published during a broker outage are lost. The gateway retries every 30 seconds; the error log says why.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (plenum_buffer_disabled{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Device freshness
panels.description: Seconds since each device last completed a successful cycle. Orange after 1 minute, red after 5. There is no per-point age (one series per point would not fit the free plan); a point that stops reading inside a working device shows in Points not read and in the log.

targets.expr: time() - max by (device) (max_over_time(plenum_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Points not read by device
panels.description: Points a device did not deliver, by reason. refused: it answered without a value (unknown object or property, a value that is not a number). not_finite: the value was NaN or Infinity, also after scaling, and was not published. The gateway log names each point once when it starts and stops failing. not_read: the device stopped answering or was busy partway through a cycle, so the rest waited for the next one. A device that does not answer at all is counted under read failures, not per point.

targets.expr: sum by (device, reason) (increase(plenum_point_read_failures_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Values pushed by device
panels.description: Values devices sent on their own between polls (BACnet change-of-value notifications), before the deadband. Each subscription also sends its current value when it is made or renewed.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (increase(plenum_pushed_readings_total{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Points pushed instead of polled
panels.description: Points kept up to date by a live change-of-value subscription, which the polling cycle skips. A drop means the device refused or stopped sending notifications, and those points are polled again.

targets.expr: max by (device) (plenum_pushed_points{service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})
{service_name="plenum-gateway", service_namespace="plenum", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | detected_level=~"warn|error|fatal"

panels.title: Failed polling cycles (traces)
panels.description: Device.pollCycle spans annotated with plenum.outcome. Click a trace ID for the span and its logs.
